Running Mechanical Crafters from Refined Storage
The Crafter Interface lets a Refined Storage Autocrafter use an array of Mechanical Crafters
Place it against any crafter of the array. Ideally the head crafter points at it, so the result goes straight into the network
An Autocrafter facing the interface sends it the ingredients of one craft. Use a processing pattern: the JEI + button builds it
The interface finds the Mechanical Crafting recipe, puts each item in its crafter and starts the array
The result goes back into the network
Right-click it, or look at it with Create Goggles, to see the array and any problem
rscreatebridge.ponder.assembly_depot.hea: Running depot machines from Refined Storage
rscreatebridge.ponder.assembly_depot.tex: A station is a Create depot with a machine two blocks above it: a mechanical press, a deployer facing down or a spout
Place an Assembly Port with its head against the depot
The RS cable goes on the port's back: the port only connects to the network through that side
The Assembly Controller uses every port on its network. An Autocrafter facing it hands it everything the pattern asks for
The controller takes each step to the right machine, loads what it needs (the deployer's item, the spout's fluid) and sends the result to the network
Only the machines a recipe uses are needed. With several ports of the same machine, several pieces are processed at once
Right-click the controller, or look at it with Create Goggles, to see the network, the ports and what is in progress
rscreatebridge.ponder.assembly_basin.hea: Running basin recipes from Refined Storage
rscreatebridge.ponder.assembly_basin.tex: Ports also work with a basin, with a mechanical mixer or press two blocks above it
If the recipe needs heat, put a blaze burner under the basin
The port goes at the basin's height: head against the basin, RS cable on its back
The controller puts the whole recipe in the basin, waits for the machine and sends the result, items or fluid, to the network
The basin must not output to the side: if it does, click it with a Create wrench until it has no output
